title: Recall implementation reports vary widely across keys without establishing consumer recovery
source_unit: CPSC Monthly Progress Report bounded 17-row recall-key snapshot

observations.period: MPR snapshot current to 2026-08-21; 17 selected recall keys with numeric-progress rows

denominator.unit: recall-key rows in bounded MPR snapshot

rows_with_numeric_consumer_percent.unit: recall-key rows with reported consumer-level percentage

rows_at_zero_consumer_percent.unit: recall-key rows with reported 0% consumer-level correction

rows_with_blank_consumer_percent.unit: recall-key rows with blank consumer-level percentage

observations.method: Bounded extraction of 17 rows from the official CPSC Monthly Progress Report MPR sheet; row-level manufacturer, distributor, retailer, consumer, total, and percentage fields were retained in the compact source audit.
observations.uncertainty: Reporting durations, recall mix, denominator definitions, product scope, and blank-field meanings are not harmonized. The MPR note states that consumer-level percentages use a consumer-held denominator that may differ from products recalled.
observations.subgroup: Selected recall keys with numeric progress in the August 2026 MPR snapshot; not a random or comprehensive recall sample.
observations.counterinterpretation: Heterogeneous reported correction percentages do not identify consumer need, notice reach, completed repair or replacement, safe restoration, or comparative firm performance without harmonized exposure and reporting clocks.

related_sources.claim: Bounded MPR row universe, schema, and selected recall-key values.
Named recall-key bridge illustrating denominator and receipt boundaries.
Second named recall-key bridge illustrating a different denominator mismatch.

boundary: This is a purposive 17-row administrative implementation snapshot, not a recall completion rate or consumer welfare estimate. It does not establish purchaser exposure, notice, repair/refund receipt, safe restoration, residual cost, trust, switching, or exit.
